mapper.sql: id, name, description, processing_scope, enabled, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM team WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM team WHERE name = #{name} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ticket WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND deleted = 0 AND status NOT IN ('CLOSED', 'CANCELLED')

SELECT DISTINCT t.id, t.name, t.description, t.processing_scope, t.enabled, t.create_time, t.update_time, t.create_by, t.update_by, t.deleted FROM team t
INNER JOIN team_member tm ON tm.team_id = t.id AND tm.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = tm.user_id AND u.deleted = 0
WHERE t.deleted = 0
AND (t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.processing_scope LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND u.department_id = #{departmentId}
AND t.enabled = #{enabled}
ORDER BY t.create_time DESC, t.id DESC
